analysis: Format: single-image static Meta ad, 1:1 square, premium minimalist ecommerce layout with top headline, discount banner, code bar, left stacked before/after lifestyle panels, right hero product-in-hand. Mechanism: comparison/old routine vs our product. Zones: top = brand/category and urgency; left upper = pain before; left lower = desired after; right = product hero and proof of offer. Rival/ours: no separate rival product shown, only before/after lives; our side is the pouch. Before/after: top-left discomfort and hidden puffy legs; bottom-left relief, confidence, lighter legs. Pain/desire: heavy swollen legs, sock marks, boots not zipping vs lighter ankles by evening, boots zip, one glass a day.
